confess_seo_low.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_low.text: *Seoyeon takes the rooftop key out of her bag, then, as if changing her mind, puts it back in her pocket.* Sorry, but let's stop here today. The way things are now, I don't think we can get any closer.

confess_yuna_low.name: Yuna
confess_yuna_low.text: *Yuna looks for a moment toward the annex, where the dusk has settled, then quietly turns away.* Let's part here today. The way I feel now, it's hard to go any deeper with you.

confess_dain_low.name: Dain
confess_dain_low.text: *Dain walks toward the dark gym, then stops short and adjusts the strap of her ball bag.* Let's just head in from here today. If we talk any more now, it'll only weigh on both of us.

confess_seo_1.name: {name}
confess_seo_1.text: *By the time the evening sunset casts long shadows, the date is over, and Seoyeon and I have walked back side by side to the school gate.*

confess_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_2.text: I don't want to just say goodbye. Let's go up to the roof for a minute.

confess_seo_3.name: {name}
confess_seo_3.text: *I follow Seoyeon up to the school roof. Below the wire railing the sunset fades, and the field lights come on one by one.*

confess_seo_4.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_4.text: *Seoyeon steps half a step back from the railing and stops in front of me. When she slips the key into her pocket, the evening wind brushes her long hair across my cheek.*

confess_seo_4_b.name: {name}
confess_seo_4_b.text: *The fingertips I slip into my pants pocket catch on the crumpled confession note I rewrote over and over last night.*

confess_seo_5.name: {name}
confess_seo_5.text: *I decide not to take out the paper I brought. I draw a deep breath and look straight into Seoyeon's eyes, where the sunset light flickers.*

confess_seo_choice.name: {name}
confess_seo_choice.text: *In a silence close enough that our breath meets, only the key ring in Seoyeon's palm gives a small jingle.*
choices: I’ll say how I feel once Seoyeon says it first.
At this point, we shouldn’t need words to know how we feel.

confess_seo_yes_1.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_yes_1.text: Wait. I heard what you just said right, didn't I? Don't even think about brushing it off as a joke now. *Seoyeon's unsteady eyes lock onto mine.*

confess_seo_yes_2.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_2.text: *I wet my burning lips once and, instead of the note in my pocket, step half a step closer to Seoyeon's fingertips.*

confess_seo_yes_3.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_3.text: I'm not joking. I like you, Seoyeon. This isn't just for today. I want to keep meeting you, right beside you, from now on.

confess_seo_yes_4.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_4.text: *Seoyeon bites her lower lip, unable to get the words out. Ragged breaths rise and fall along her flushed neckline.*

confess_seo_yes_5.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_5.text: It must have been sudden, so you don't have to answer right now.

confess_seo_yes_6.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_yes_6.text: If you kindly leave me a way out like that, I can't think about anything else.

confess_seo_yes_7.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_yes_7.text: Let's not go down yet. I want to stand here like this a little longer. *Seoyeon gently tugs the end of my sleeve.*

confess_seo_yes_8.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_yes_8.text: The truth is, I've been watching only you since the first day you transferred.

confess_seo_yes_9.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_yes_9.text: Where you sit in class, who you're with when you laugh, even when you go quiet over what you're thinking. All of it.

confess_seo_yes_10.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_10.text: I didn't know you were watching me that closely. *When I cover the back of Seoyeon's hand, she lays her palm over mine.*

confess_seo_yes_11.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_yes_11.text: Let's meet at lunch tomorrow, just the two of us. I'll leave the roof door open ahead of time so only you can come in.

confess_seo_yes_11_b.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_yes_11_b.text: *Leaving a warm trace where our fingertips were clasped, Seoyeon slowly starts toward the stairwell door.*

confess_seo_yes_12.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_yes_12.text: I should have dropped my pride and said it first. Hearing it straight from you, I can barely breathe. *Seoyeon's ear is flushed red at the bottom of the stairs.*

confess_seo_no_1.name: {name}
confess_seo_no_1.text: The wind feels nice. Want to stay here a little longer together, then head down?

confess_seo_no_2.name: {name}
confess_seo_no_2.text: *Seoyeon looks at my lips for a moment, then quietly steps half a step aside by the railing and makes room for me.*

confess_seo_no_3.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_no_3.text: *Side by side, close enough that our shoulders almost touch, we look down at the darkening field. In the quiet, one more field light comes on.*

confess_seo_no_4.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_no_4.text: If you happen to be free at lunch tomorrow, come up to the roof.

confess_seo_no_4_b.name: {name}
confess_seo_no_4_b.text: *All the way down the roof stairs behind Seoyeon, the note I never managed to give her sits in my pocket, damp with sweat from my hand.*

confess_yuna_1.name: {name}
confess_yuna_1.text: *Around the time orange lights come on one by one across the café signs along the street, Yuna stops and tips her chin slightly toward the school annex.*

confess_yuna_2.name: Yuna
confess_yuna_2.text: Before we part, there's one last place I really want to go with you.

confess_yuna_3.name: {name}
confess_yuna_3.text: *The reading space in the annex, where I followed Yuna in. The sunset coming through the window settles deep onto the armrest of the old sofa.*

confess_yuna_4.name: Yuna
confess_yuna_4.text: Come sit next to me. We don't have to open a book today. *Yuna leans back into the sofa and looks up at me.*

confess_yuna_5.name: {name}
confess_yuna_5.text: *When I sit next to Yuna, the sofa cushion sinks and our shoulders touch.*

confess_yuna_choice.name: {name}
confess_yuna_choice.text: *Yuna slowly smooths the folded corner of the bookmark with her thumb and meets my eyes from close enough that my breath reaches her.*
choices: I’ll answer if Yuna asks me first.
Yuna should know how I feel even if I don’t say it.

confess_yuna_yes_1.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_1.text: *Trying not to break the quiet air of the reading room, my voice sinks low and deep on its own.*

confess_yuna_yes_2.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_2.text: *The moment I open my mouth, Yuna's thumb, smoothing the corner of the bookmark, stops where it is.*

confess_yuna_yes_3.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_3.text: Yuna, I like you. When it's just the two of us, I don't have to put on an act or swallow what I want to say.

confess_yuna_yes_3_b.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_3_b.text: The time I spend breathing beside you has been the most comfortable, and the most precious, thing to me.

confess_yuna_yes_4.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_4.text: *Yuna sets the bookmark she was holding down on the sofa cushion without a sound.*

confess_yuna_yes_5.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_5.text: Even after today's date ends, I want to stay beside you tomorrow, and the day after that.

confess_yuna_yes_6.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_6.text: I'm not trying to pressure you, so you don't have to answer right away.

confess_yuna_yes_6_b.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_6_b.text: *With a small brush of the sofa fabric, Yuna straightens and leans a handspan closer toward me.*

confess_yuna_yes_7.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_7.text: *On the sofa where the sunset has settled, Yuna's fingertips search out the edge of my sleeve instead of the bookmark.*

confess_yuna_yes_8.name: Yuna
confess_yuna_yes_8.text: *As if hiding the unsteadiness in her eyes, Yuna keeps her gaze toward the shelves and grips the end of my shirt sleeve tight with two fingers.*

confess_yuna_yes_8_b.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_8_b.text: *The crumpled end of my sleeve winds deep into Yuna's small, hot palm.*

confess_yuna_yes_8_c.name: Yuna
confess_yuna_yes_8_c.text: Promise me. If you're ever going to disappear from in front of me, you'll tell me first.

confess_yuna_yes_9.name: Yuna
confess_yuna_yes_9.text: Don't leave me alone without even a goodbye. I don't want to lose you either.

confess_yuna_yes_9_b.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_9_b.text: *Yuna's grip on my sleeve tightens, and with my other hand I quietly cover the back of that slender hand.*

confess_yuna_no_1.name: {name}
confess_yuna_no_1.text: The sunset light is warm, and this place feels really nice.

confess_yuna_no_2.name: Yuna
confess_yuna_no_2.text: *Without a word, Yuna pushes the bookmark deep between the closed pages, then dips her chin a little.*

confess_yuna_no_3.name: {name}
confess_yuna_no_3.text: Yuna, you still haven't finished the book on your lap? *Yuna does not open the pages, only traces the title letters on the cover with her fingertip.*

confess_yuna_no_4.name: Yuna
confess_yuna_no_4.text: Yeah. I still haven't seen the ending that matters most.

confess_yuna_no_4_b.name: {name}
confess_yuna_no_4_b.text: *When I get up and take about three steps toward the door, I look back, and past the book Yuna's deep-red eyes hold onto my back for a long time.*

confess_dain_1.name: {name}
confess_dain_1.text: *As the downtown date draws to a close, Dain strides ahead toward the school's back gate, as if she has decided something.*

confess_dain_2.name: Dain
confess_dain_2.text: Before we head home, let's stop by just one last place.

confess_dain_3.name: {name}
confess_dain_3.text: *I follow Dain into the empty gym on a weekend evening. Under the high ceiling, only the side lights along the edge of the court are faintly on.*

confess_dain_4.name: Dain
confess_dain_4.text: I didn't come to practice at this hour. But is it okay if I hold a ball? If I stand in front of you empty-handed, my fingertips shake. *Dain pulls a volleyball to her chest.*

confess_dain_choice.name: Dain
confess_dain_choice.text: *The volleyball slips from her hand and thumps up off the wooden floor. A beat late, Dain's outstretched fingertips brush the side of the ball in midair.*
choices: Shall we sit on the bench a little longer?
I’ll say how I feel once Dain says it first.
At this point, we shouldn’t need words to know how we feel.

confess_dain_yes_1.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_1.text: *When I call Dain's name, the first syllable comes back off the empty gym walls in a low, clear echo.*

confess_dain_yes_2.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_2.text: *I take one step right up to Dain, steady my hot breath, and open my mouth again.*

confess_dain_yes_3.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_3.text: Dain. Before we part today, there's something I have to tell you.

confess_dain_yes_3_b.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_3_b.text: I like you. Not just a weekend date like today. From now on, I want to keep walking beside you.

confess_dain_yes_4.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_4.text: *Dain slowly sets the volleyball she was hugging to her chest down on the wooden floor.*

confess_dain_yes_5.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_5.text: If your feelings are a mess, you don't have to answer right now.

confess_dain_yes_6.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_6.text: I just wanted you to know first how much I mean it.

confess_dain_yes_7.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_7.text: *Under the quiet gym's orange light, Dain's short breaths and warm body heat reach all the way to my chin.*

confess_dain_yes_8.name: Dain
confess_dain_yes_8.text: Ah, what do I do. I want to give you a good answer, but don't look at my face right now! *Dain stands on the white court line and covers her bright-red face with both palms.*

confess_dain_yes_8_b.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_8_b.text: *The volleyball on the floor taps the toe of my sneaker and rolls aside, but Dain can't even think of going after it.*

confess_dain_yes_9.name: Dain
confess_dain_yes_9.text: Wait just a second. My breath is right up in my throat, and I can't sort out a single word in my head.

confess_dain_yes_9_b.name: Dain
confess_dain_yes_9_b.text: I'm smiling because I'm happy, so why are the corners of my eyes getting hot too. *Dain looks at me through her fingers and laughs, then rubs her eyes with the back of her hand.*

confess_dain_yes_10.name: Dain
confess_dain_yes_10.text: Come see me tomorrow too. I won't dodge it then. I'll give you my answer properly.

confess_dain_yes_10_b.name: Dain
confess_dain_yes_10_b.text: *Instead of the ball that rolled away, Dain grabs the front of my shirt once, lets go, and gives me a dazzling smile.*

confess_dain_no_1.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_1.text: We walked a lot, so want to sit on that bench a little longer before we go?

confess_dain_no_2.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_2.text: *I sit beside Dain on the bench in the corner of the court. The confession that rose all the way to my throat never makes it past my lips.*

confess_dain_no_3.name: Dain
confess_dain_no_3.text: *Still seated, Dain bounces the volleyball on the floor twice. On the third bounce it leaves her hand and rolls off into the dark beyond the court.*

confess_dain_no_4.name: Dain
confess_dain_no_4.text: Next time we come here alone, say the thing you just swallowed.

confess_dain_no_4_b.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_b.text: *Head lowered, Dain rips the Velcro of her wrist brace open in one long tear.*

confess_seo_yes_mid_1.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_yes_mid_1.text: Sorry, but I don't think I can give you a definite answer right here. I'll leave the roof door open at lunch tomorrow, though.

confess_seo_yes_low_1.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_yes_low_1.text: *Seoyeon quietly slips the rooftop key deep into her pocket.* Let's stop here today. I'm not ready yet to take what you just said into my heart.

confess_yuna_yes_mid_1.name: Yuna
confess_yuna_yes_mid_1.text: It's hard to put my answer into words right now. Even so, don't disappear from beside me.

confess_yuna_yes_low_1.name: Yuna
confess_yuna_yes_low_1.text: *Yuna pushes the bookmark deep between the pages and closes the book.* I'm sorry. Today, I won't take the feeling you offered me.

confess_dain_yes_mid_1.name: Dain
confess_dain_yes_mid_1.text: Sorry. My feelings aren't sorted out enough to answer right away. Even so, don't run from in front of me.

confess_dain_yes_low_1.name: Dain
confess_dain_yes_low_1.text: *With a stiff expression, Dain adjusts the strap of her ball bag.* I can't take those words yet. Head back for today.

confess_seo_yes_neg.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_yes_neg.text: *Seoyeon puts the key in her pocket with a cold look.* We're not on terms right now to trade a confession like that.

confess_yuna_yes_neg.name: Yuna
confess_yuna_yes_neg.text: *Yuna coldly slides the bookmark in between the pages.* I'll act like I didn't hear what you just said. I'm not taking it.

confess_dain_yes_neg.name: Dain
confess_dain_yes_neg.text: *Dain adjusts the strap of her ball bag, her face gone cold.* Sorry, but I have no intention at all of hearing that from you right now.
